rows.explainer: Rough guess. Taimaka predicts some children would move from government to Taimaka treatment programs. "When a government CMAM Center is operating alongside several of our own OTPs, I would expect it to be the case that some of the patients being treated in the government facility would be able to travel to Taimaka's OTPs, while some would not be able to (and vice versa)... I unfortunately don't have a great sense of how much of an overlap there is in this sense, but my (fairly uninformed) guesstimate is ~50% of the government cases." Email from Taimaka, September 17 2024.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
